del_message.reply_required: Please send this command in reply to a message.
del_message.too_old: ❌ This message is older than 48 hours; Telegram does not allow deleting it.
del_message.capped_warning: ⚠️ Requested delay exceeded the limit. Telegram only allows deletion up to {max_time} after the message was sent; the schedule was capped.
del_message.error_not_found: Message not found (may have been deleted already)

ui.unscheduled: ✅ Scheduled deletion cancelled; this message will not be removed.
ui.not_scheduled: This message was not on the deletion list.
ui.cancelled: ❌ Cancelled. Reply /del on the correct message to start again.
ui.session_expired: Session expired. Send /del on the message again.

to_jpg.no_image: The selected message does not contain an image file. Only image files are accepted.
to_jpg.not_image_document: The selected file is not an image.
to_jpg.heic_not_supported: HEIC format is not supported. Please install pillow-heif.

translate.reply_required: Please send this command in reply to a message containing text.
translate.no_text: The selected message does not contain text to translate.
